armored: At the start of each round, incoming damage is multiplied by a random value between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}}.
dwarf: At the start of each round, your size is randomly set between {{minScale|multiplier}} and {{maxScale|multiplier}}.
friendlyfire: Shooting teammates heals them for {{healthDamageMultiplier|percent}} of the damage dealt.
miner: Your HE grenade detonates only when an enemy is within {{detonationRange}} units. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
reactivearmor: Armor absorbs the first damage taken, then recharges after {{cooldown|seconds}}.
shade: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to teleport {{teleportDistance}} units behind the enemy.
soundmaker: Player screams can be heard every {{cooldown|seconds}}.
demoneye: You deal {{damage}} damage to every enemy you are looking at every {{secondCooldown|seconds}}.
thorns: Attackers receive {{healthTakenScale|percent}} of the damage they deal to you, capped at {{maxTakenDamagePerShot}} damage per shot.
dash: Perform a second jump to dash with {{jumpVelocity}} vertical velocity and {{pushVelocity}} forward velocity. Any direction: {{anyDirection}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
ninja: Standing still increases your invisibility by {{idlePercentInvisibility|percent}}, crouching by {{duckPercentInvisibility|percent}}, and holding a knife by {{knifePercentInvisibility|percent}}.
throwingknife: Click [css_useSkill] to throw a knife that deals {{damage}} damage. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
explosiveshot: Each shot has a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to create an explosion dealing {{damage}} damage in a {{damageRadius}} unit radius.
baseball: Your decoy moves at {{speedMultipier|multiplier}} speed, up to {{maxSpeed}} velocity, and deals {{damageDeal}} damage on impact. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
hermit: Killing restores ammo and {{healthToAdd}} health. Effect duration: {{effectDuration|seconds}}.
planter: You can plant the bomb anywhere, with {{extraC4BlowTime|seconds}} added to its detonation time.
knockback: Firing while airborne pushes you backwards by {{knockbackUnits}} units, up to {{maxSpeed}} speed.
flashlight: Click [css_useSkill] to toggle a flashlight with {{range}} unit range and {{brightness|multiplier}} brightness. It blinds enemies within {{blindAngle}} degrees for {{blindDuration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
antyflash: You are immune to flashbangs, and your flashbangs last {{flashDuration|seconds}}. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
anomaly: Click [css_useSkill] to rewind {{secondsInBack|seconds}} back in time. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
gambler: Select a skill from the list. Refreshing the list costs {{refreshPrice|currency}}.
smoker: Your smoke grenades never run out. Active grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
assassin: Attacks from behind deal {{damageMultiplier|multiplier}} damage within a {{toleranceDeg}} degree tolerance.
healingsmoke: Your smoke heals {{smokeHeal}} health per tick within {{smokeRadius}} units. Tick interval: {{tickCooldown}}. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
deathbomb: You explode upon death for {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}.
thirdeye: Click [css_useSkill] to activate third person view at a distance of {{distance}} units.
takeammo: Click [css_useSkill] to take the active weapon magazine from a random enemy. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
hotbomb: While you are alive, the bomb carrier takes {{damage}} damage every {{cooldown|seconds}}.
carefulbullets: Select a player who takes {{damageAfterMiss}} damage for every missed shot.
spectator: Click [css_useSkill] to spectate a random enemy from {{distance}} units away. Update interval: {{useCooldown|seconds}}.
magneticdecoy: Your decoy pulls players within {{triggerRadius}} units with {{strenght}} strength. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
astronaut: At the start of each round, your gravity multiplier is randomly set between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}}.
holyhandgrenade: Your HE grenades deal {{damageMultiplier|multiplier}} damage with {{damageRadiusMultiplier|multiplier}} range. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
fortnite: Click [css_useSkill] to create a barricade with {{barricadeHealth}} health. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
toxicsmoke: Your smoke deals {{smokeDamage}} damage per tick within {{smokeRadius}} units. Tick interval: {{tickCooldown}}. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
glaz: You can see through smoke grenades. Active grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
longknife: Knife attacks reach up to {{maxDistance}} units. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
chicken: You get a chicken model, move faster, and have reduced health.
catapult: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to launch the enemy upwards.
frozendecoy: Your decoy freezes players within {{triggerRadius}} units with a {{slownessMultiplier|multiplier}} slowness multiplier. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
pilot: Double click jump to fly with {{maximumFuel}} fuel. Fuel consumption: {{fuelConsumption}}. Refuelling rate: {{refuelling}}.
healingchicken: You spawn {{amount}} chickens that heal {{heal}} health per tick within {{healRadius}} units. Tick interval: {{tickCooldown}}.
killerflash: Anyone fully blinded for {{flashDuration|seconds}} by your flashbang dies. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
push: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to push the enemy with {{pushVelocity}} horizontal and {{jumpVelocity}} vertical velocity.
expensiveammo: A chosen enemy pays {{moneyPerShot|currency}} for every shot.
watchmaker: Every grenade throw changes the round time by {{changeRoundTime|seconds}}.
retreat: Click [css_useSkill] to return to spawn. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
swapposition: Click [css_useSkill] to swap places with a random enemy after {{cooldownBeforeUse|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
teamteleport: Press [css_useSkill] to teleport to a teammate within {{teleportDistance}} units and {{teleportAngle}} degrees of your aim. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
pyro: Molotov damage restores health with a {{regenerationMultiplier|multiplier}} multiplier. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
disarmament: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to make the enemy drop their weapon.
magnifier: Force a chosen enemy to use a {{customFOV}} degree field of view.
secondlife: After lethal damage, you respawn with {{startHealth}} health.
replicator: Click [css_useSkill] to create a replica. It deals {{enemyTeamDamage}} damage to enemies and {{yourTeamDamage}} damage to teammates. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
tripwire: Place a wire up to {{maxWallDistance}} units long, {{wireHeight}} units high, and {{wireWidth}} units wide. Trigger radius: {{triggerRadius}} units. Enemies stay visible for {{radarDuration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
jester: Jester mode prevents dealing and receiving damage. The mode changes after a random interval between {{minTime|seconds}} and {{maxTime|seconds}}.
weightless: Your grenades ignore gravity and fly faster. Active grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
dracula: Hitting an enemy restores {{healthRegainScale|percent}} of the damage dealt as health.
illusionist: Click [css_useSkill] to deploy a replica for {{durationRun|seconds}} while running or {{durationCrouch|seconds}} while crouching. It deals {{enemyTeamDamage}} enemy damage and {{yourTeamDamage}} teammate damage. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
iana: Click [css_useSkill] to control your hologram for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
cypher: Click [css_useSkill] to create or switch to a camera. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
medic: Click [css_useSkill] to restore {{healthToAdd}} health. Charges: {{healthShotLimit}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
enemyspawn: Click [css_useSkill] to teleport to the enemy spawn after {{cooldownBeforeUse|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
nightmare: Force a chosen enemy into a vision that fades over {{fadeTime|seconds}}, with exposure between {{minExposure}} and {{maxExposure}}.
fragilebomb: Shooting the bomb damages it. Bomb health: {{maxBombHealth}}.
lastgasp: After you die, deal {{damageAfterDeath}} damage to your killer. Can kill: {{canKill}}.
phoenix: After lethal damage, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to respawn.
magneto: Enemy grenades within {{radius}} units are repelled away from you.
psychicdefusing: When you are within {{maxDefusingRange}} units of the bomb, you defuse it in {{defusingTime|seconds}}.
robinhood: Dealing damage steals money using a {{moneyMultiplier}} money multiplier.
blastshot: Press Attack2 with the MP5 to fire an HE grenade dealing {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius with {{force}} force. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
jumpcurse: A chosen enemy jumps with {{jumpVelocity}} velocity whenever a teammate jumps.
flash: At the start of each round, your speed multiplier is randomly set between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}}.
rambo: At the start of each round, receive between {{minExtraHealth}} and {{maxExtraHealth}} extra health.
jetkick: Select a player whose shots push them backwards with {{pushVelocity}} velocity.
explodingbarrel: Click [css_useSkill] to place a barrel that explodes for {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
berserker: As your health decreases, speed increases up to {{maxSpeedVelocity|multiplier}} and damage up to {{maxDamageVelocity|multiplier}}.
poison: Choose a player who takes {{damage}} damage every {{cooldown|seconds}} until reaching {{minHealth}} health.
godmode: Click [css_useSkill] to become immortal for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
blademaster: While holding a knife, torso shots are deflected with {{torseReflectionChance|percent}} chance and leg shots with {{legReflectionChance|percent}} chance. Deflected velocity multiplier: {{velocityModifier|multiplier}}.
teleporter: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to swap places with the enemy.
paweljumper: You receive between {{extraJumpsMin}} and {{extraJumpsMax}} extra jumps.
randomweapon: Click [css_useSkill] to receive a random weapon. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
richboy: At the start of each round, receive between {{minMoney|currency}} and {{maxMoney|currency}}.
falconeye: Click [css_useSkill] to activate a bird eye camera at a distance of {{distance}} units.
longzeus: Zeus attacks reach up to {{maxDistance}} units. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
bunnyhop: Auto bunny hop with {{jumpVelocity}} jump velocity, {{jumpBoost|multiplier}} boost, and a maximum speed of {{maxSpeed}}.
weaponsswap: Click [css_useSkill] to swap weapons with a random enemy. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
rubber: Your bullets slow players for {{slownessTime|seconds}} to a {{slownessModifier|multiplier}} movement multiplier.
soldier: At the start of each round, your damage multiplier is randomly set between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}}.
noclip: Click [css_useSkill] to enable noclip for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}. Stuck recovery cooldown: {{cooldownWhenStuck|seconds}}.
aimlock: Click [css_useSkill] to lock your aim for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
giant: Enlarge a chosen enemy to a random size between {{minScale|multiplier}} and {{maxScale|multiplier}}.
behind: On hit, you have a random chance between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}} to turn the enemy to face the opposite direction.
homingnades: Grenades home toward enemies with {{strength}} strength and {{maxVelocity}} maximum velocity, detonating within {{detonationRange}} units. Grenade limit: {{grenadeLimit}}.
rezombie: After lethal damage, respawn as a zombie with {{zombieHealth}} health and no weapons.
